blocks.html:
QueryIndexFunction is a wrapper on top of indexModule
that simplifies the input it accepts and returns
a normalized/consistent output.

blocks.title: Deprecated
blocks.html: The Index Module is deprecated and will be removed in a future release. Use `query.graph()` instead, which filters across linked modules: https://docs.medusajs.com/learn/fundamentals/query#filter-by-linked-data-models-property
